name: A Glass Float
description: A green glass net-float as big as two fists, in a cage of tarred cord, frosted by the sea. Turned to the light it goes green inside, like looking up from under a wave. Off Wrackholm's come-home pile: floats are the one thing the sea always gives back, kept a year and a tide for whoever lost them. Nobody came for this one. Something lost, and something good: for Pell.
